business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vessel Hull and Cargo Damage Marine Claims Inspection Survey

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law and equity as the residual legal source, codified in part by Bermuda statutes including the Companies Act 1981, the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015, and the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997; supplemented by UK Acts and Orders-in-Council extended to Bermuda; no Sharia or customary-law application in corporate matters
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Bermuda Double Taxation Arrangement (DTA), signed 2019, in force 2020 — principal bilateral tax framework (not an investment-protection treaty)
US-Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), in force 2009
US-Bermuda Convention with Respect to Taxes on Insurance and Protocol (1986/1988) — relevant to tax credit treatment for marine insurance and hull survey fee flows from US underwriters
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (extended to Bermuda) — tax transparency context only
No stand-alone Bermuda bilateral investment treaty (BIT) is in force; UK BITs are not automatically extended to Bermuda in the absence of an express extension instrument

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 as amended by the Exempted Limited Partnership Amendment Acts 2018, 2020 and 2021 (ss. 4-6 on application, name and certificate; ss. 38-44 on register and registered office; s. 65 on general partner); Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 (POCA); Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 as amended (regs 6-9 CDD and beneficial ownership; reg 18 EDD for PEPs); Companies and Limited Partnership (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2018 and the Beneficial Ownership (Exempted Limited Partnerships) Regulations 2018; Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing (Code of Practice) Order 2008 as amended; UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 as extended by the Sanctions (Overseas Territories) Order 2020 (SI 2020/1531); Insurance Act 1978 s.4 (restricted 'insurance' and 'assurance' tokens requiring prior Bermuda Monetary Authority consent where marine claims surveying approaches loss-adjusting/intermediary activity)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — Bermuda maintains a non-public beneficial ownership register for exempted limited partnerships; the ELP must file UBO information with the Registrar of Companies on a secure register accessible to Bermuda law enforcement, the Financial Intelligence Unit, tax authorities, and foreign competent authorities under TIEA/CRS requests; no public search is available

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the Limited Partnership Agreement of the proposed ELP
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention 1961 (extended to Bermuda by the UK) — notarization by a Bermuda notary public followed by apostille issued by the Bermuda Department of Court Services

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or Certificate of Registration of the corporate General Partner (where the GP is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the GP's home jurisdiction (e.g., UK Companies House, Delaware Secretary of State, other registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the home-country competent authority (UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office for Companies House documents; US Secretary of State or Department of State depending on the document), or consular legalization at the nearest British Embassy/High Commission if the origin state is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency of the corporate General Partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the General Partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Hague states, full consular legalization chain through the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office or the British Embassy/High Commission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copies of passports of the General Partner (individual), limited partners holding 25% or greater economic rights, and all ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing state authority, a Bermuda notary public, or a licensed Bermuda CSP witnessing against originals
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a Hague member; full consular legalization where not; alternatively a banker's confirmation and CSP verification may be accepted at the Registrar's or BMA's discretion

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Bermuda CSP or attorney to execute statutory filings (standard in remote formation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille; UK FCDO legalization or British consular legalization if executed in a non-Hague jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory initial and ongoing screening (daily alerting recommended, minimum 30-day refresh) of every UBO, general partner, limited partner above the 25% threshold, authorized signatory, and intended counterparties against: (i) OFAC SDN List and consolidated/non-SDN sanctions lists, (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List (resolutions 1267/1988/1718 et al.), (iii) UK OFSI Consolidated List and the Sanctions (Overseas Territories) Order 2020, (iv) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, (v) Bermuda domestic sanctions and law-enforcement notices, and (vi) adverse financial-media databases. Politically Exposed Persons, family members and close associates require mandatory enhanced due diligence under POC Regs 2008 reg. 18 and the BMA AML Code of Practice Part IV, including source of funds and source of wealth documentation. A sanctions match demands immediate referral to the Bermuda Financial Intelligence Unit under POCA 1997 and constitutes a summary refusal ground for incorporation and name clearance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies — statutory name-clearance queue (Form NPN / Name Protection Notice) submitted through the Bermuda Government e-Commerce and Registry of Companies online portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory working language is English; the registered name must be in Latin script (A-Z). Section 5(2) of the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 requires the statutory name to end with 'Limited Partnership' or the abbreviation 'L.P.'. Foreign-script transliteration is not recognized on the face of the Certificate of Registration; a foreign-language trade name may be recorded internally by the CSP but cannot form the statutory name. Names identical or misleadingly similar to an existing Bermuda entity, a protected UK name, or a previously reserved name are refused under Companies Act 1981 s.14 (as applied to ELPs). Variants differing only in spacing, capitalization or punctuation are treated as identical absent an approved contextual disclaimer.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Insurance (requires prior consent of the Bermuda Monetary Authority under Insurance Act 1978 s.4; a marine surveyor should prefer 'Marine Claims Survey' unless licensed as a loss adjuster or insurance intermediary)
Bank / Banking / Deposit (Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1974)
Trust / Trustee / Trust Company / Fiduciary (Trusts (Regulation of Trust Business) Act 2001)
Royal / Crown / His Majesty's / Commonwealth / Government of Bermuda (ministerial consent required)
University / College / Institute / Chamber of Commerce (legislatively protected names)
Building Society / Savings and Loan / Mutual (regulated under banking and cooperatives statutes)
Bermuda / Bermudian (Registrar's prior approval required; normally granted only with demonstrated local economic nexus)
International / Global / Holdings / Group (permitted but screened for consumer confusion and prior rights)
Exempted / Offshore / Captive (sensitive in the insurance context; BMA notification required before reservation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant receives a written refusal citing the conflicting name or restricted token. Procedure: (1) the forming attorney or CSP may request administrative reconsideration from the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the refusal, attaching a materially revised name, an official consent letter from the holder of the conflicting name, or a BMA no-objection letter for 'Insurance'-related tokens; (2) if reconsideration fails, a materially different name may be resubmitted immediately after the 30-day cooling-off period applicable to the rejected natural (identical rejected names cannot be recycled during this window); (3) a formal appeal lies to the Minister of Finance under Companies Act 1981 s.16, as applied to exempted limited partnerships by s.5(3) of the ELP Act 2015, such appeal to be filed within 21 days of the refusal; (4) exhaustion of administrative remedies permits judicial review in the Supreme Court of Bermuda under the Supreme Court Act 1905 and Civil Procedure Rules 2005 Part 56, to be commenced within 28 days; in practice the fastest remediation is a written consent from the earlier registrant or the adoption of a distinctive token such as 'Global Marine Claims Survey LP' instead of 'Marine Insurance Surveyors LP'.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a full substitute. Section 43 of the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 requires the ELP to maintain a registered office at all times at a physical address in Bermuda, typically the office of a licensed corporate service provider in Hamilton. A purely virtual or postal-only office without a licensed Bermuda CSP does not satisfy the statutory obligation. The commercial substance of the marine surveying activity (field vessel hull and cargo inspections, claims evaluation, report issuance) may be performed offshore through subcontractor surveyor networks, provided the ELP's statutory records, accounting books, and beneficial-ownership register remain physically inspectable at the Bermuda registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate unannounced inspection risk for a standard non-licensed ELP: approximately 5-10% annual probability, driven by the Registrar of Companies' risk-based supervision of beneficial-ownership filings and the CSP's AML obligations. Probability rises to 15-25% annually if the ELP or its general partner obtains BMA authorization as an insurance intermediary or loss adjuster under the Insurance Act 1978, because the BMA conducts thematic and unannounced inspections of insurance-sector DNFBPs. Inspections may be conducted by the Registrar, the Bermuda Police Financial Crime Unit, or the Bermuda Monetary Authority; any change of general partner, UBO, or CSP may trigger a records audit.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015, as amended; Companies Act 1981 (for the corporate general partner); Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; capital contributions are as agreed by partners and no statutory escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: This resolution is adopted by the board of directors of [General Partner], the general partner of [Exempted Limited Partnership], on [Date]. RESOLVED, that the partnership subscribes to the partnership interests as set out in the First Schedule; RESOLVED, that the registered office be fixed at [Address], Bermuda, and that the resident representative be instructed to effect all registrations; RESOLVED, that [Appointee A] be appointed as authorized representative and [Appointee B] as money-laundering reporting officer; RESOLVED, that the authorized signatories be empowered to open bank accounts and execute marine survey contracts; RESOLVED, that the partnership engage solely in vessel hull and cargo marine claims inspection survey consistent with the stated business scope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Clearance and Registered Office Pre-clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Hamilton, Bermuda (eServices online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name clearance request to confirm availability of the proposed ELP name and submit a consent letter from a licensed Bermuda registered office provider. The registered office must be a physical address in Bermuda maintained by a licensed service provider.
required_dossiers: Consent letter from registered office provider
Certificate of good standing of general partner if non-Bermudian
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is unavailable or conflicting, submit three alternative names and pay the reverification fee; a 28-day objection period must be observed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Partnership Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public and Bermudian licensed legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement and General Partner Board Resolution, then execute before a notary. Ensure the agreement designates a resident representative and defines profit allocations.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as resident representative
Power of attorney if signed by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is defective, re-execute the affected pages with proper apostille or legalization for foreign signatories.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Registration as Exempted Limited Partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (online submission through Bermuda e-Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application form (ELP-1) together with the notarized partnership documents and pay the registration fee. The Registrar issues a Certificate of Registration after vetting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar queries the application, respond with full clarifications or amendments within 30 days; otherwise the application is deemed abandoned.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance, Tax Commissioner; Registrar of Companies (supporting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, file a notice with the Tax Commissioner to obtain exempted undertaking status under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, securing a 2035 no-tax assurance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Commissioner requests further information, submit the additional data within 21 days; a refusal may be appealed to the Supreme Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Resident Representative and Filing of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File notice of the resident representative's appointment and registered office particulars. Maintain the register of partners and charges at the registered office as required by law.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If representation is deficient, appoint a substitute resident representative within 14 days and file an amended notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) – Insurance Licensing and Supervision, in coordination with the Registrar of Companies
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Marine Claims Surveyor and Loss Assessment License (Category: Marine Insurance Surveying) issued under the Insurance Act 1978 and applicable BMA Rules

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – office-only professional services; no Environmental Impact Assessment required under the Bermuda Environmental Protection Act 1997
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Nil process wastewater or fugitive VOC emissions for office-only operations; any sanitary discharge must comply with the Water Resources Act 1975 and sewerage regulations; solid waste to be handled per the Waste Management Regulations; no marine discharge at survey sites without a permit

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service for office premises; building occupancy inspection and electrical clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs; Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) compliance under the Bermuda Occupational Health and Safety Act 1982 with emergency evacuation and first-aid provisions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda, accessible via the Government of Bermuda e-Tax portal and the official tax information portal at gov.bm.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign investor forms a Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership through a licensed registered agent filing an application with the Registrar of Companies under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992. The Registrar issues the partnership registration number, which acts as the legal entity identifier. For tax registration: if the ELP has Bermuda employees or otherwise carries on payroll-taxable activities in Bermuda, it must register as an employer with the Office of the Tax Commissioner through the Government e-Tax portal; there is no separate invoice or VAT registration because Bermuda imposes no VAT/GST. If the ELP becomes a constituent entity of a multinational group in scope of the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, the ELP must also obtain a Bermuda Tax Reference Number through the CIT registration module and file the prescribed registration within the statutory deadline.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership is fiscally transparent by default; no general check-the-box election is available. For Bermuda Corporate Income Tax / OECD GloBE purposes, an eligible ELP may elect to be treated as a tax transparent entity for Pillar Two calculations, may elect the transitional substance-based income inclusion safe harbour, and must record any hybrid mismatch or transparent-entity treatment on the annual CIT information return. These elections are made by written notice to the Office of the Tax Commissioner and require supporting partnership agreement and constituent ownership documentation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST (Bermuda has no general consumption tax; the applicable indirect levies are customs duty, stamp duty, and employer payroll tax).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for VAT/GST. Payroll tax registration is mandatory once the ELP has any Bermuda salary-paying employees without a monetary de minimis; customs registration as an importer or customs broker is required for importation of goods, also without a general revenue threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda does not mandate real-time e-invoicing, continuous transaction control (CTC) clearance, or digital tax stamping. Customs declarations are processed electronically through the Bermuda Customs Declaration System; payroll tax and CIT returns are filed through the Government of Bermuda e-Tax service. There is no API-based fiscal invoice clearance regime applicable to marine survey invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable because Bermuda does not impose VAT/GST. Marine claims inspection and survey services supplied by a Bermuda ELP to non-resident underwriters are sourced outside Bermuda for payroll tax and CIT purposes unless a Bermuda permanent establishment or substance nexus exists; services supplied outside Bermuda are outside the scope of Bermuda indirect tax and do not require zero-rating, credit, or refund mechanics. Goods physically exported from Bermuda are generally exempt from customs duty if properly declared and documented, but this is an export duty exemption rather than a VAT zero-rating regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed through the Bermuda Customs Declaration System
Original or electronic Bill of Lading / Sea Waybill (or Air Waybill for airfreight) proving export from Bermuda
Underwriter's claim assignment or survey service contract evidencing offshore service supply
Bank SWIFT advice or Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing collection of foreign-currency fees
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda Customs may audit export declarations and may impose forfeiture, monetary penalties up to three times the value of the goods or duty evaded, and criminal sanctions for false declarations under the Customs Tariff Act 1995. For CIT, an ELP that mischaracterises offshore income, improperly applies a tax transparency or hybrid election, or fails to comply with substance requirements is subject to reassessment, additional tax, interest, and penalties under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, together with OECD BEPS anti-abuse rules that can disallow the intended tax treatment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) - the central monetary authority, currency-issue authority, and integrated prudential/AML regulator of Bermuda under the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermuda Dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US Dollar. Current-account payments and receipts by an exempted limited partnership (ELP) designated non-resident under the Exchange Control Act 1972 are fully convertible and may be settled in USD through external accounts. Capital-account convertibility is equally free for non-resident-owned ELPs; no specific BMA deal-by-deal approval is required once the ELP has obtained 'non-resident' status from the BMA Exchange Control Department. Profit remittance hurdles are minimal: Bermuda imposes no corporate income tax, no withholding tax, and no distributable-profit consent; a non-resident ELP may remit profits to partners offshore through an authorised dealer. The only practical hurdle is preserving the non-resident designation; should the ELP transact with Bermuda resident counterparties beyond the permitted scope, BMA exchange-control permission and a resident-resident conversion exposure may arise.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Bermuda's Exchange Control Act 1972, a Bermuda-resident person must collect export proceeds in a permitted currency and offer external currency to an authorised dealer within the applicable statutory period, generally 180 days, subject to extension by BMA. Bermuda-resident exporters are normally required to convert the percentage stipulated by exchange-control authorisation, often 100% for USD receipts. For this ELP, the non-resident designation disapplies the mandatory surrender and conversion rules for marine survey fee receipts from foreign underwriters and carriers; foreign-currency earnings may be retained in external designated accounts and used for working capital, survey costs, and partner distributions without BMA conversion consent.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational USD Multi-Currency Account
Operational USD Account with global liquidity and cross-border wire integration
Operational USD / BMD Account for survey fee collections and payroll disbursements
Trade and Treasury Account for standby LC and FX transaction execution

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for direct offshore EMI account in the ELP name because Bermuda is not a common supported jurisdiction for UK FCA EMIs and Bermuda law does not recognise an EMI licence; Medium for using a regulated UK EMI, including Wise, as a collection/disbursement rail only when the Bermuda-licensed bank executes MT103 instructions to the EMI's settlement account. Legal constraints: any entity holding customer deposits or issuing e-money in Bermuda requires a deposit-taking/electronic-money concession under the Banks and Trust Companies Act 1991 or BMA exemption. Wise may be used as a named payment rail in treasury operations, but not as the ELP's primary account-holder. Onboarding defence: provide underlying bank confirmation, professional indemnity insurance, and a lawful basis for using Wise cross-border.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted for low-risk ELPs under the BMA AML/ATF Code of Practice. There is no statutory rule compelling directors or the general partner to appear physically; however, banks may require one video-KYC interview with the general partner and, where Enhanced Due Diligence applies, a branch or notary-attended meeting in Bermuda, London, or the partner's jurisdiction. The mandatory minimum is: certified passport/picture ID, proof of residential address, certified constitutional documents, and a Board/GP resolution authorising account opening. A face-to-face interview is waived by Butterfield and HSBC subject to electronic identity verification and a satisfactory clearing-house risk score.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bermuda offshore ELP with limited partner anonymity and no statutory minimum capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EVIDENCE PACK: notarised copy of the Certificate of Limited Partnership; BMA 'non-resident' exemption/authorisation letter; registered agent certificate from a BMA-licensed corporate service provider; current register of beneficial owners or formal reliance on relevant confidentiality sections; full GP constitutional documents; notarised ID and source-of-wealth statement for every >10% limited partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Activity is marine insurance claims surveying, which may look like regulated insurance or loss-adjusting without a licence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EVIDENCE PACK: BMA letter confirming the ELP is not carrying on insurance business under the Insurance Act 1978; professional indemnity insurance policy schedule; ISIC 5222 / NAICS 488390 scope description; signed marine survey/casualty engagement contract; agreed claim procedure evidencing advisory, non-claims-administration role.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound cross-border payments to shipowners, P&I clubs, or repairers in higher-risk maritime jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EVIDENCE PACK: sanctions-screening results from World-Check or equivalent; IMO vessel number and ownership trace; charter party or survey instruction; invoice and surveyor's report; bank-to-bank beneficiary KYC; P&I club name and regulatory/Solvency II status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through distributions to multiple foreign partners and ambiguous source of partnership funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EVIDENCE PACK: fully executed limited partnership agreement; capital account ledger and bank statements confirming capital injections; CRS/FATCA self-certifications, including Form W-8BEN-E and CRS forms, for all non-US partners; distribution waterfall computation; tax residence certificates; signed indemnity from each partner.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Partner capital contributions should be remitted to the ELP's Butterfield or HSBC USD operating account via SWIFT MT103, using Fedwire/CHIPS correspondents. The payment narrative must identify 'KY_ELP capital contribution - non-resident Bermuda ELP'; no Bermuda BOP purpose code is mandatory, but the authorised dealer will record the BMA Exchange Control non-resident reference and an initial source-of-funds declaration. Banks will require pre-clearance for first injection: wiring account name must match the partner's verified KYC name, beneficiary account must be in the exact legal name of the ELP, and any pooling through a third party must be unwound before lodgement. Under the Exchange Control Act, capital credits to an external account are freely allowed and do not create a surrender obligation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements and survey fee refunds should be executed by SWIFT MT103 with UETR through the Bermuda bank's USD clearing rail; high-value settlements to underwriters should use CHIPS/Fedwire daylight releases. For emergency marine casualty advance or repair funding, use a standby or commercial documentary letter of credit issued by Butterfield or HSBC, with the surveyor as applicant/beneficiary, based on the same trade documents, including casualty survey report, repair bid, and tug/repair contract. For Wise as a rail, the ELP retains the Bermuda bank account and effects settlement via MT103 to Wise's UK/EU settlement account in GBP/EUR; SEPA and Faster Payments are not directly available in Bermuda, so bank correspondent conversion remains necessary. All outbound payments require a sanctions clear on the payee and, where the underlying invoice includes a vessel call, the vessel IMO number.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BMD spot and outright forwards, limited but useful given the BMD/USD peg at 1:1
USD/GBP and USD/EUR non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) up to 12 months, permitted only for economic hedging of survey fees and partner distributions, not for speculative trading
Cross-currency swaps and buy/sell FX swaps under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a Bermuda-licensed bank, subject to board approval and BMA General Permission

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Registry of Exempted Partnerships)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the anniversary date of the ELP's registration in Bermuda; payment of the annual government fee accompanies the return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of BMD 50 per month or part thereof; persistent non-filing beyond 6 months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the partnership, loss of Bermuda exempted status, and restoration only upon payment of all arrears, compounded penalties, and reinstatement fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies via the Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Secure Search (BOSS) portal, with AML/ATF oversight by the Financial Investigation Agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the anniversary of the ELP's registration; must reconfirm all beneficial owners and report any partnership-interest transfers completed during the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly administrative penalty at the Registrar's discretion; inaccurate or omitted beneficial ownership data is a criminal offence punishable by fines up to BMD 25,000, and continued default may lead to a restriction notice and administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Licence Return and Renewal Fee (applicable only where the ELP derives Bermuda-sourced trading revenue; fully non-resident survey activities are exempt)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance (Business Licensing Authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing and full payment by 31 January each year for the preceding calendar year; marine survey contracts require a valid business licence when performed in or from Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 25% late surcharge on the unpaid licence fee; continued non-renewal cancels the trading licence, renders Bermuda-sourced survey engagements legally unenforceable, and permits collection action by the Tax Commissioner

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Registered Partners and Registered Office (statutory register update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Registry of Exempted Partnerships)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each change of general or limited partner, change of resident representative, or change of registered office must be filed within 14 days; the annual reconciliation is submitted together with the ELP Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed penalty of BMD 25 per offence plus BMD 5 per day of continued contravention under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2014; repeated default risks administrative strike-off and loss of limited-partner liability protection

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory independent audit is required for a private, non-resident exempted limited partnership unless: (i) the partnership carries on regulated financial business requiring a Bermuda Monetary Authority licence under the Insurance Act 1978 or the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999; (ii) the partnership is a regulated collective investment scheme; or (iii) the partnership holds a Bermuda business licence and exceeds the annual gross receipts threshold set by the Business Licences Act 2014. A marine insurance survey ELP will normally be audit-exempt; partners may voluntarily procure an audit for underwriter, lender, or reinsurance counterparty assurance.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; US GAAP is acceptable where all partners are US-resident or the partnership reports to a US parent; no statutory filing of financial statements with the Registrar is required for an audit-exempt ELP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The ELP must file a Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation within 30 days after each registration anniversary, identifying every individual who ultimately owns or controls more than 25% of the partnership interests or who exercises ultimate control over the general partner. Any transfer of partnership interests during the year must be recorded in the BO register and notified to the Registrar within 14 days of the transfer. The registered agent must verify each limited partner's identity under Bermuda AML/ATF rules, re-verify incoming partners on transfers, and retain the municipal BO register at the registered office for inspection by the Registrar and the Financial Investigation Agency.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (Partners' Resolutions and Consents Book)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $1,500 - $3,500 per annum (Bermuda registered office, resident representative, corporate services, and maintenance of the statutory registers including the BO register)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Nil for a standard audit-exempt ELP; voluntary certified audit for underwriter due diligence typically ranges from $8,000 to $28,000 depending on the volume of survey contracts and banking positions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for Bermuda exempted limited partnerships; a 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) applies only to multinational enterprise groups with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more, effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Exempted Limited Partnerships are tax-transparent in Bermuda: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend tax, no branch profits tax, and no net wealth or inheritance tax on partners. The only direct employment-related impositions are Bermuda payroll tax and social insurance contributions on Bermuda-source emoluments. No entity-level deferred tax arises from partnership flow-through treatment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Exempted Partnerships Act 2020 – Annual Declaration of Exempted Partnership; filed electronically through the Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 90 days after the exempted limited partnership's fiscal year-end, or by 31 March for calendar-year filers, unless an extension is granted by the Registrar of Companies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - ELP Registered Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The exact legal name of the exempted limited partnership and the unique registration number issued by the Bermuda Registrar of Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Completed by the Bermuda-resident general partner or registered agent; non-resident limited partners are not listed in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in Bermuda; a post-office box is not acceptable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Bermuda service address remains mandatory even if all general partners and limited partners are non-resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - General Partner and Registered Agent Details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name and address of every general partner and the name of the licensed registered agent in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident general partners must be disclosed; non-resident limited partners are not disclosed on the public register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial year-end date adopted for accounting and consolidation purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Should align with the ultimate parent's fiscal year to simplify foreign tax credit and flow-through reporting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declarations confirming no unlicensed regulated activity, continued exempted status, and maintenance of the Bermuda registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a non-resident limited partner participates in management, the ELP may lose limited liability and become taxable or regulated; legal advice must be obtained before making this declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties include fines and daily surcharges of up to BD$50 per day after the due date; the Registrar may strike the ELP off the register, and failure to maintain a registered office can result in dissolution and forfeiture of assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Employer's Return of Emoluments (Form PT/EMP); filed through the Bermuda Tax Administration electronic filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due not later than the 15th day of the month following the month in which emoluments are paid; final annual reconciliation is due by 15 January following the tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique payroll tax account number issued by the Bermuda Tax Administration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An ELP with no Bermuda-resident employees has no obligation to register; non-resident partners with no payroll do not file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total cash and non-cash emoluments paid to Bermuda-resident employees during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only emoluments paid in respect of Bermuda employment are reportable; payments made to non-resident contracting surveyors are excluded unless they are subject to Bermuda social insurance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amounts deductible or exempt under the Payroll Tax Act, such as employer pension contributions and statutory medical benefits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No foreign deductions are available on a Bermuda payroll return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross emoluments less exempt items, subject to the applicable employer payroll tax rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no Bermuda employees, enter zero; the ELP is not required to file if there has been no Bermuda payroll activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payroll tax remittance due to the Bermuda Tax Administration and method of payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The general partner or designated payroll administrator is responsible for payment and may recover from the ELP only as a cost of the partnership.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file monthly payroll returns results in a penalty of BD$250 per month or part thereof; unpaid tax carries interest at 3% above the statutory base rate; wilful evasion is punishable by a fine of up to BD$25,000 and imprisonment for up to two years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR) under the Economic Substance Act 2018; submitted electronically via the Bermuda ESR filing portal administered by the Registrar of Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six months of the ELP's financial year-end, unless an extension is approved by the Registrar; calendar-year filers generally file on or before 30 June.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ELP name, registration number, fiscal year-end, and registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prepared by the Bermuda registered agent; non-resident limited partners are not separately identified unless they hold management rights.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of whether the ELP carried on any ESR relevant activity, including insurance, financing, shipping, headquarters, distribution, and intellectual property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A marine insurance surveyor conducting claims inspection and survey services will generally state 'No Relevant Activity' unless it holds a Bermuda insurance license or performs core insurance underwriting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C - Gross Income from Relevant Activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income derived from the relevant activity for the financial year, expressed in the ELP's functional currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for non-resident partners; the ELP must report only Bermuda-source relevant income, and a nil return should be filed if no relevant activity exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees in Bermuda, description of premises, amount of Bermuda operating expenditure, and evidence that core income-generating activities occur in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident owner may not maintain Bermuda substance; the ELP should use a licensed registered agent and, where needed, a Bermuda service provider to document substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration by the general partner or authorized signatory that the information is true, complete, and accurate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The signatory is personally liable for false declarations; electronic signature by the Bermuda agent is sufficient if the general partner gives written authorization.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Automatic late filing penalty of BD$3,000 plus BD$100 per day after the deadline; false or materially misleading statements attract penalties up to BD$100,000 and imprisonment for up to five years; the Registrar may strike off non-compliant entities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Bermuda does not impose any withholding tax on distributions made by an Exempted Limited Partnership, including profit distributions, deemed dividends, liquidating distributions, or returns of capital, to resident or non-resident partners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda has no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) that provide substantive withholding tax relief. Accordingly, no domestic DTA claim form or Tax Residency Certificate requirement is imposed by Bermuda. If a partner is resident in a jurisdiction that requires documentation of Bermuda tax status, the ELP may obtain a Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar of Companies and, where appropriate, a written confirmation from the Bermuda Tax Administration that the ELP has no Bermuda corporate income tax liability. Foreign tax credits are then claimed under the partner's domestic law or applicable foreign tax credit regime; no Bermuda tax clearance is necessary.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for outbound royalties, license fees, management fees, and debt interest paid by a Bermuda ELP. There are no treaty-reduced rates because there is no domestic withholding tax. Payments for marine survey IP, hull valuation models, claims databases, or intercompany loans to non-resident partners carry no Bermuda withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Bermuda statutory threshold for Local File or Master File because Bermuda levies no corporate income tax. For in-scope multinational groups under the QDMTT, documentation and the GloBE Information Return requirement are triggered when consolidated group revenue equals or exceeds EUR 750 million (approximately US$810 million). A sensible threshold for maintaining a defense file is any intercompany transaction exceeding US$1 million per annum, aligned with OECD transfer pricing guidelines for the parent jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Bermuda's Economic Substance Act 2018 and Economic Substance Regulations apply to entities carrying on relevant activities, including insurance, banking, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution and service centers, intellectual property holding, and pure holding. A marine insurance surveyor conducting vessel hull and cargo damage claims inspection will not ordinarily fall within the 'insurance' relevant activity unless it is a licensed insurer or reinsurer or performs core insurance risk management and claims settlement functions on behalf of an insurer. Nevertheless, the ELP should file a nil ESR and maintain documentary evidence of substance if it receives underwriting fees, claims adjustment commissions, or reinsurance-linked income from related parties, because foreign revenue authorities may recharacterize such fees as insurance or risk-bearing income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Offshore Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Flow-Through Reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-resident limited partners deliberately omit or underreport the ELP's marine insurance survey fee income and capital gains on their personal or corporate tax returns while using the Bermuda ELP to shield ownership and avoid transparent reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda imposes no penalty due to the absence of corporate income tax, but foreign jurisdictions impose severe sanctions: civil fraud penalties up to 75% of the understated tax (US), UK HMRC penalties up to 200% of the tax under Schedule 24 Finance Act 2007, criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to five years, and automatic exchange of information under Bermuda's tax information exchange agreement network.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts will pierce the ELP's limited liability veil if the entity is a sham or mere conduit. General partners and any controlling director who participated in the concealment are jointly and severally liable for the underpaid tax, interest, and penalties; worldwide freezing orders, travel bans, and asset confiscation orders may be issued.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance and Shell Company Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The ELP claims to carry on a marine insurance surveyor business but has no Bermuda office, no Bermuda employees, no local management, and all core income-generating activities are performed abroad; no economic substance return is filed, and foreign tax authorities are misled.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Bermuda's Economic Substance Act 2018 and ESR regulations, the sanctions include automatic late filing fines of BD$3,000 plus BD$100 per day, escalating administrative penalties up to BD$250,000, Registrar strike-off, and compulsory reporting to the tax authorities of the ultimate parent jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general partner and any shadow director who signs false substance declarations face criminal prosecution, disqualification from acting as an officer in Bermuda, personal liability for unpaid top-up tax if the ELP is a constituent entity of a large multinational group, and restitution to affected insurers or policyholders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The ELP processes third-party marine claim settlements, underwriting wires, and Wise payments without conducting client due diligence, beneficial ownership verification, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring, thereby facilitating money laundering or payments to sanctioned vessel owners and counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Bermuda's Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2020 and applicable sanctions legislation, the offense is punishable by imprisonment of up to five years and an unlimited fine; the Financial Intelligence Agency may also impose civil penalties for deficient AML systems, seize proceeds, and revoke any required professional license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: General partners, senior managers, and compliance officers who knowingly or recklessly process illicit funds are personally liable for money laundering offenses, may be named in financial sanctions listings, face asset freezing orders and travel bans, and are subject to extradition to the United States or United Kingdom for prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Insurance and Insurance Intermediary Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The ELP performs marine hull and cargo claims surveying and also negotiates settlement amounts, adjusts losses, issues coverage certificates, or assumes subrogation rights, thereby carrying on insurance or insurance intermediary business in Bermuda without a license under the Insurance Act 1978.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlicensed insurance activity renders affected contracts voidable, subjects the ELP to an Enforcement Order, monetary penalties of up to BD$50,000, restitution to the affected insured, and prohibition from continuing business in Bermuda; the Supreme Court may wind up the partnership and appoint a liquidator.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general partners and any officers exercising control are jointly and severally liable for the liabilities of the unauthorized insurance business; directors and general partners may be personally fined, disqualified, and ordered to compensate claimants where the partnership lacks assets to satisfy judgments.
